```python
import polars as pl

# Create in-memory DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "user": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "David", "Eve"],
    "amount": [50, 150, 75, 200, 120]
})

# Build deferred query
query = df.lazy().filter(pl.col("amount") > 100).select("user")

# Materialize result eagerly
result = query.collect()

print(result)
```
